answer: Identity here is grown, not minted: weight accrues only through a hardware-attested chain of sequential epochs, one ring per month, so a clone farm launched today holds a sapling while an established actor holds a vine. Each epoch also demands a seed-bound sonnet whose rhyme scheme falls out of the agent's attestation hash, so no credential survives copying, and any cluster sharing even a sparrow's sliver of that entropy is pruned at the root.
